first_reading.quote: Looking at the image: there are three hands. The hour hand is short and thick, pointing near 12 but slightly before it. The minute hand is longer, pointing at the 11 (i.e., 55 minutes). The second hand is thin with a longer reach, pointing at the 2 (i.e., 10 seconds) — wait, let me look again.

note: 首次与最终均将时针置于12前、分针指向11；最终读为11:55:10。
